_comment: Reviewed reachability registrations (ADR-0555). Each entry registers a tree (dir prefix ending '/') or an exact path as reached, and MUST carry an anchor naming WHY. Registration is a review-visible design act — the ADR-0551 trust class (same as ratchet-policy.json) — never a silent exemption. Hand-edited (or via the transitional --fix-reachability bridge); the producer fails LOUD on a malformed entry.

registered.anchor: ADR-0555 ownership seed: the cloud-ci gate tree's OWNERS marker (cloud-ci-platform)
ADR-0559 ownership seed: the cloud-iam service tree's OWNERS marker (axis-cloud-platform)

ADR-0555 D3: the governance decision corpus — every decision is crosswalk-accounted (decision-crosswalk.generated.json); orphan/unpropagated/status pathologies are the cross-artifact gate's BLOCKING codes, so per-decision reachability is derived from the corpus itself, not hand-mentioned per file
ADR-0555 D3: gate/agent evidence corpus — TTL-accounted decay (staleness-reaper budgets); evidence is reached by the gate runs that produced it
ADR-0555 ownership seed: the specs tree's OWNERS marker (council-architecture)

ADR-0556 D1: the cache-warmth classification policy-as-data — reached by its named consumers (interim CI quick-wins, the W3 NativeLink CAS vertical, the future cache-policy-conformance gate) and by ADR-0556 related_specs

ADR-0562 §2: the CLOSED capability registry policy-as-data — the single source of truth for the capability-first repo organization, reached by the ADR-0562 deterministic placement rule + the §6 membership lint (its named consumer) + ADR-0562 related_specs; held at specs/ until the governance/ top-level dir exists
ADR-0555 D3: the gates' data-under-test corpus — fixture dirs are loaded wholesale by each gate's fixture-driven test (read_dir over tc-*.json), so the consuming test IS the live pointer
ADR-0555: this registry registers itself — a reviewed root registration surface pointed at by oya-ci.toml [reachability].registry
ADR-0555 D3: reindeer-vendored third-party tree — a DERIVED class regenerated from Cargo.lock (drift impossible by regeneration); its accounting is the lockfile + buckification, not per-file mentions

ADR-0560 D1: NativeLink CAS deployable artifacts — the warm-substrate manifests consumed at cluster bring-up (GitOps apply); keyed mTLS boundary + SeaweedFS S3 backing per the ADR; ownership seed infra/nativelink/OWNERS (cloud-ci-platform)

ADR-0560 D3: opt-in buck2 cache overlays — selected ONLY by the oya-cloud-ci-cache-wiring-app resolver under the specs/cache-warm-license.json kill-switch; conformance-gated (overlay posture + dark-wiring guarantee); ownership seed infra/ci/buckconfig/OWNERS (cloud-ci-platform)

ADR-0560 D3: the cache-only execution platform (toolchains//cache:cache-platform) the overlays select; mirrors prelude//platforms:default with [oya_cache] knobs; ownership seed toolchains/cache/OWNERS (cloud-ci-platform)

ADR-0560 D2 (executing ADR-0556 D2): the warm-license kill-switch DATA read by the cache-wiring resolver and pinned by its conformance gate; ships warm_reads_licensed=false until the first GREEN canary against a live substrate

ADR-0560 D4 (executing ADR-0556 D2 'no canary, no warm'): the scheduled cold integrity-canary workflow — from-empty pinned build + assert-cold + digest manifests + verdict artifact; shape pinned by the oya-cloud-ci-cache-wiring-app conformance gate
ADR-0555 ownership seed: the workflows tree's OWNERS marker (cloud-ci-platform) — added with ADR-0560's canary workflow so new workflow files are born owned
ADR-0561 ownership seed: the cloud-os trustd-domain crate's OWNERS marker (axis-cloud-platform) — added with slice-1b-i's der.rs so the trustd crate's new real-X.509 source is born owned
